role: Postdoctoral Research Associate — public presentation: R&D Project Manager
summary: Created a molecular-communication laboratory and an operational testbed combining chemistry, microfluidics, instrumentation, electronics, signal processing and machine learning.

projectType.label: Project type
projectType.value: Creation of a laboratory and an experimental testbed

directContributions.label: Laboratory
directContributions.text: Created the laboratory from scratch, including premises, equipment, fume hoods, consumables, safety procedures and protocols.

directContributions.label: Team
directContributions.text: Managed an average team of five people and trained nine people in total.

directContributions.label: Funding
directContributions.text: Managed two EPSRC grants of €300k and €60k.

directContributions.label: Artificial intelligence
directContributions.text: Developed a one-dimensional CNN using Python, TensorFlow and scikit-learn to analyse UV-Vis signals.

directContributions.label: Instrumentation
directContributions.text: Designed and manufactured six open-source syringe pumps using Fusion 360, 3D printing, Arduino, I²C, C++ and Python.

finalState.title: State at the end of the project
finalState.text: The laboratory was created, the experimental testbed was operational, six open-source syringe pumps were designed and manufactured, and the work produced two scientific publications for which I was the first author and principal writer.
